variants.name: A：角に溶けるグラデーション
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI mockup.
Input image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET: a real portrait iPhone screenshot of a Japanese pixel-art focus app. Output ONE full portrait screenshot at the same composition and proportions, no device frame, no side-by-side, no extra labels.
Change ONLY the top-left header area containing ネオンの向こうの屋上 and the row 5/5 with five connected warm cream dots. This means roughly x28–465, y100–230 in the 591×1261 input. Preserve the exact existing Japanese title, elegant serif type at same size, rank 5/5 and exactly FIVE filled connected dots. Rank is complete, so DO NOT add a remaining-time caption or extra text. Keep left alignment and original header location with careful spacing.
Everything else is invariant: same highly detailed pixel art city, building signs, girl typing, holographic screen, foliage, lamp, colors and artwork framing; same status bar 18:47, 作業中 badge, huge 45:48 at original position, Night Signal and MUSIC OFF at right, cream pause circle and outline finish circle, 一時停止 / 終了 glass captions, bottom frosted tab bar and exact icons/text. No repositioning or restyling these other UI components. Do not simplify or redraw the scenery. Only remove/replace the two ugly rounded glass header backgrounds as described below. High fidelity realistic implementable iOS screenshot, not conceptual art. Design A — remove BOTH rounded rectangular header backgrounds completely. Put title and dot row directly over a continuous softly feathered navy-black corner scrim anchored to top-left. Scrim is strongest immediately behind text, fading completely toward the right and down by y255. No visible shape edges, no rounded boxes, no border, no glass slab. Keep the scenic neon details softly visible through the darkening. Beautiful cinematic readability with an airy integrated look. Five dots remain small and refined.
